phase: Aggregate Bank Credit — Prudential Population and Consolidation Boundary Review
purpose: Determine whether retained ECB CBD2 Romania prudential series are definitionally equivalent to the BNR prudential indicators intended as Romanian banking-system state controls. This is a semantic/population review; model fit and numerical proximity are not admission criteria.

official_evidence.source: Monthly Bulletin January 2025, Table 11.1 — Main prudential indicators
findings: BNR states that the prudential indicators cover only banks that are Romanian legal entities.
From June 2014 the indicators use the EU 680/2014 supervisory-reporting framework; from June 2021 that framework is replaced by EU 2021/451.
The table publishes exact quarterly prudential values and is the definitionally preferred anchor for a BNR-population series.
BNR separately reports Romanian-legal-entity credit institutions and branches of foreign legal-entity credit institutions.
The Romanian-legal-entity category includes institutions with majority foreign capital, so legal incorporation in Romania is not equivalent to domestic control/ownership.

official_evidence.source: Consolidated banking data — key definitions relating to domestic banks
findings: CBD2 domestic-bank data concern domestically controlled banking groups and stand-alone banks.
For banking groups, the consolidated-banking framework includes cross-border and cross-sector consolidation.

official_evidence.source: ECB Data Portal CBD2 dataset metadata
findings: The retained Romania series use CBD reference sector breakdown 11: domestic banking groups and stand-alone banks.
The retained NPL ratio is additionally limited to FINREP reporters, while retained solvency/CET1 controls use the full-sample reporting-framework code.

bnr_anchor.population: Banks that are Romanian legal entities; foreign-bank branches are a separate category.
bnr_anchor.ownership_implication: Includes Romanian-incorporated institutions with majority foreign capital.

ecb_cbd2_sector_11.population: Domestic banking groups and stand-alone banks.
ecb_cbd2_sector_11.control_basis: Domestically controlled banks/groups under the CBD framework.
ecb_cbd2_sector_11.consolidation: Banking groups are consolidated across borders and sectors.
ecb_cbd2_sector_11.reporting_framework_note: The retained NPL ratio is FINREP-reporters; retained solvency/CET1 controls use the full-sample code.

current_source_disposition.cbd2_role: Diagnostic/cross-source prudential evidence only; not a definitionally matched replacement for the BNR anchor.
current_source_disposition.reason_chart_digitisation_not_required: BNR Monthly Bulletins publish the relevant indicators as exact statistical tables; future recovery should parse and retain table values under a preregistered source-vintage contract rather than digitise charts.
current_source_disposition.next_admissible_source_task: No active matched-prudential source-discovery task remains. Reopen only on genuinely new official BNR evidence: an exact unresolved Monthly Bulletin link/archive listing, a stable machine-readable series/export/API with matched population metadata, or an explicit population/consolidation bridge. Do not repeat the same discovery probes.
reopen_triggers: An official machine-readable BNR series on the Romanian-legal-entity bank population is identified.
A deterministic retained BNR Monthly Bulletin table-extraction path is preregistered and passes exact semantic/provenance review.
An official source publishes an explicit mapping/common-sample bridge between the BNR Romanian-legal-entity population and CBD2 sector 11 with consolidation treatment documented.
